itemdesc-philosophersstone: Right-click a block to transmute it (stone types, wood types, sand and gravel...). Sneak to go the other way. Change the area with the tool-mode key. Never used up in crafting recipes.
itemdesc-transmutationtablet: A transmutation table you can carry. Right-click to open it anywhere.
itemdesc-alchemicalfuel-alchemicalcoal: Burns hotter and far longer than charcoal. Works in forges and fire pits.
itemdesc-alchemicalfuel-mobiusfuel: Four alchemical coal, folded into one.
itemdesc-alchemicalfuel-aeternalisfuel: Barely contained fire. The base of dark matter.
itemdesc-matter-dark: Condensed equivalence. Tools made from it never wear out.
itemdesc-mattertool-dark-pickaxe: Never wears out. Use the tool-mode key to dig a 3x3 area; sneak to dig a single block.
itemdesc-mattertool-dark-shovel: Never wears out. Use the tool-mode key to dig a 3x3 area; sneak to dig a single block.
itemdesc-mattertool-dark-axe: Never wears out. Use the tool-mode key to dig a 3x3 area; sneak to dig a single block.
itemdesc-mattertool-dark-hammer: Smashes through stone, ore and other hard blocks 3x3 at a time. Use the tool-mode key to switch to a single block, or sneak. Never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-red-pickaxe: Never wears out. Use the tool-mode key to dig a 3x3 or 5x5 area; sneak to dig a single block.
itemdesc-mattertool-red-shovel: Never wears out. Use the tool-mode key to dig a 3x3 or 5x5 area; sneak to dig a single block.
itemdesc-mattertool-red-axe: Never wears out. Use the tool-mode key to dig a 3x3 or 5x5 area; sneak to dig a single block.
itemdesc-mattertool-red-hammer: Smashes through stone, ore and other hard blocks 3x3 at a time, or 5x5 with the tool-mode key. Sneak for a single block. Never wears out.
blockdesc-transmutationtable: Burn items into EMC to learn them, then create anything you've learned from your EMC.
blockdesc-energycollector-mk1: Turns sunlight into EMC. Feeds a condenser placed next to it; sneak + right-click with an empty hand to take the EMC yourself.
blockdesc-energycollector-mk2: Turns sunlight into EMC. Feeds a condenser placed next to it; sneak + right-click with an empty hand to take the EMC yourself.
blockdesc-energycollector-mk3: Turns sunlight into EMC. Feeds a condenser placed next to it; sneak + right-click with an empty hand to take the EMC yourself.
blockdesc-energycondenser-mk1: Put an item in the target slot: the condenser burns everything else inside it (and EMC from collectors) to make copies of it.
blockdesc-energycondenser-mk2: Put an item in the target slot: the condenser burns everything else inside it (and EMC from collectors) to make copies of it.
gui-burn-hint: Drop an item on the burn slot to turn it into EMC and learn it. Left-click burns the whole stack, right-click burns one.
gui-create-hint: Left-click: take one  ·  Right-click: take a stack  ·  Shift-click: stack straight into your inventory
condenser-notarget: EMC {0}. Put an item in the target slot.
error-noaccess: You need to be at a transmutation table or carry a transmutation tablet.
error-hascontents: Empty {0} first - it still has things inside.
error-cursorbusy: Put down what you're holding first.
error-notransmutable: The philosopher's stone can't transmute this block.
cmd-holdsomething: Hold an item in your active hotbar slot.
cmd-recalc: Mapped {0} EMC values in {1} ms from {2} conversions.
cmd-missing: {0} of {1} blocks/items have no EMC value. Biggest groups: {2}. Full list: {3}
cmd-missing-none: All {0} blocks/items in the creative inventory have an EMC value.
chat-announce: Vintage-E version {0}: calculated {1} EMC values, {2} missing.
chat-announce-cached: Vintage-E version {0}: {1} EMC values (calculated earlier, nothing has changed), {2} missing.
missing-summary: {0} of {1} blocks/items in the creative inventory have no EMC value ({2} values calculated, Vintage-E {3}). Give them values in ModConfig/vintagee.json (BaseValues) or a config/vintagee-emc.json asset, then /emc recalc.
missing-summary-none: All {0} blocks/items in the creative inventory have an EMC value (Vintage-E {1}).
missing-copied: Copied {0} codes to the clipboard, ready to paste into BaseValues.
missing-empty: Nothing is missing - every block and item has an EMC value.
error-noprivilege: Only admins (controlserver privilege) can change EMC values.
missing-select: Click a name to give it a value (admins).
missing-badvalue: Type a number (0 or more) first.
cmdhelp-notadmin: Commands marked (admin) need the controlserver privilege.
cmdhelp-emc: Your EMC, and the EMC value of the item you're holding.
cmdhelp-missing: Opens a searchable list of blocks/items with no EMC value, where you can give them one. Also writes ModData/vintagee/emc-missing.csv.
cmdhelp-set: Gives the held item a fixed EMC value (0 removes its value). Saved to ModConfig/vintagee.json; values are recalculated.
cmdhelp-clear: Removes the fixed value you set for the held item.
cmdhelp-recalc: Recalculates every EMC value from the loaded recipes.
cmdhelp-dump: Writes every value, and what it was worked out from, to ModData/vintagee/emc-values.csv.
cmdhelp-give: Adds EMC to your personal EMC.
cmdhelp-learn: Learns the held item for transmutation without burning it.
itemdesc-covalencedust-low: Crafting dust for alchemical gear. Made from stone and charcoal.
itemdesc-covalencedust-medium: Crafting dust for alchemical gear. Made from iron and saltpeter.
itemdesc-covalencedust-high: Crafting dust for alchemical gear. Made from diamond and coke.
itemdesc-kleinstar-ein: Stores EMC. Right-click to empty it into your EMC, sneak + right-click to fill it. Rings and gadgets draw from stars you carry. Combine four into the next size (their EMC is kept).
itemdesc-trinket-blackholeband: While on: pulls loose items around you to you. Works anywhere in your hotbar or backpack; right-click to switch on/off.
itemdesc-trinket-swiftwolfsrendinggale: While on: you run 40% faster and take no fall damage. Costs a little EMC while on.
itemdesc-trinket-harvestgoddessband: While on: crops around you grow faster (costs EMC per growth stage).
itemdesc-trinket-ignitionring: While on: hostile creatures near you catch fire, and fire can't hurt you. Costs EMC per burn.
itemdesc-trinket-zeroring: While on: still water around and below you freezes into ice.
itemdesc-trinket-ringofarcana: Zero Ring, Ignition Ring, Harvest Goddess Band and Swiftwolf's Rending Gale in one. Pick the mode with the tool-mode key.
itemdesc-trinket-bodystone: While on: keeps you fed using EMC.
itemdesc-trinket-soulstone: While on: heals you using EMC.
itemdesc-trinket-lifestone: While on: keeps you fed and heals you using EMC.
itemdesc-trinket-repairtalisman: While on: slowly repairs every damaged item and piece of armour you carry. Free.
itemdesc-trinket-gemofeternaldensity: While on: turns cheap junk you carry (stone, soil, sand, gravel, sticks... anything worth 8 EMC or less) into the target material. Pick the target with the tool-mode key.
itemdesc-trinket-evertideamulet: Right-click a block to place a water source next to it. Free.
itemdesc-trinket-volcaniteamulet: Right-click a block to place a lava source next to it. Costs EMC.
itemdesc-trinket-watchofflowingtime: While on: time runs 10x faster for the whole world - crops, cooking, curing, drying and day and night (or 3x slower, which also slows hostile creatures near you; pick with the tool-mode key). Costs EMC every second it is on.
itemdesc-gadget-destructioncatalyst: Right-click a block to break a 3x3 tunnel into it (3, 6 or 9 deep with the tool-mode key). Costs EMC per block.
itemdesc-gadget-hyperkineticlens: Right-click to blow up the spot you're looking at, up to 64 blocks away. Costs EMC.
itemdesc-gadget-catalyticlens: A bigger explosion, or the destruction catalyst's tunnel (tool-mode key). Costs EMC.
itemdesc-gadget-mercurialeye: Sneak + right-click a block to remember it, then right-click blocks to turn them into it (1x1 or 3x3). You pay the difference in EMC.
itemdesc-gadget-archangelssmite: Right-click to strike the creature you're looking at, up to 48 blocks away. Costs EMC.
itemdesc-gadget-tomeofknowledge: Right-click to learn every item that has an EMC value.
itemdesc-gadget-diviningrodlow: Right-click a block to see how much EMC lies in the ground below it (3 blocks deep).
itemdesc-gadget-diviningrodmedium: Right-click a block to see how much EMC lies in the ground below it (16 blocks deep).
itemdesc-gadget-diviningrodhigh: Right-click a block to see how much EMC lies in the ground below it (64 blocks deep).
itemdesc-redmattertool-katar: Sword, axe and shears in one: fells trees, cuts plants 3x3 or 5x5 and hits very hard. Never wears out.
itemdesc-redmattertool-morningstar: Pickaxe, shovel and sledgehammer in one: digs stone, ore and soil 3x3 or 5x5. Never wears out.
itemdesc-kleinstar-zwei: Stores EMC. Right-click to empty it into your EMC, sneak + right-click to fill it. Rings and gadgets draw from stars you carry. Combine four into the next size (their EMC is kept).
itemdesc-kleinstar-drei: Stores EMC. Right-click to empty it into your EMC, sneak + right-click to fill it. Rings and gadgets draw from stars you carry. Combine four into the next size (their EMC is kept).
itemdesc-kleinstar-vier: Stores EMC. Right-click to empty it into your EMC, sneak + right-click to fill it. Rings and gadgets draw from stars you carry. Combine four into the next size (their EMC is kept).
itemdesc-kleinstar-sphere: Stores EMC. Right-click to empty it into your EMC, sneak + right-click to fill it. Rings and gadgets draw from stars you carry. Combine four into the next size (their EMC is kept).
itemdesc-kleinstar-omega: Stores EMC. Right-click to empty it into your EMC, sneak + right-click to fill it. Rings and gadgets draw from stars you carry. Combine four into the next size (their EMC is kept).
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-white: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-plain: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-gray: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-black: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-brown: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-red: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-orange: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-yellow: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-green: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-blue: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-purple: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-pink: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-matterarmor-red-head: Never wears out. A little lighter on your feet.
itemdesc-matterarmor-red-body: Never wears out. A little lighter on your feet.
itemdesc-matterarmor-red-legs: Never wears out. A little lighter on your feet.
itemdesc-matterarmor-gem-head: Never wears out. A full set makes you immune to fall and fire damage.
itemdesc-matterarmor-gem-body: Never wears out. A full set makes you immune to fall and fire damage.
itemdesc-matterarmor-gem-legs: Never wears out. A full set makes you immune to fall and fire damage.
blockdesc-alchemicalfuelblock-alchemical: Nine alchemical coal. Burns nine times as long.
blockdesc-alchemicalfuelblock-mobiusfuel: Nine mobius fuel. Burns nine times as long.
blockdesc-alchemicalfuelblock-aeternalis: Nine aeternalis fuel. Burns nine times as long.
blockdesc-matterfurnace-dark: Smelts, fires and cooks anything with smelting data - ore straight to ingots, no crucible needed. Runs on fuel or on EMC from adjacent collectors and relays.
blockdesc-matterfurnace-red: Like the dark matter furnace, but four times as fast and hot enough for anything.
blockdesc-antimatterrelay-mk1: Stores EMC from collectors, adds a bonus and passes it on to condensers, furnaces and other relays.
blockdesc-antimatterrelay-mk2: Stores EMC from collectors, adds a bonus and passes it on to condensers, furnaces and other relays.
blockdesc-antimatterrelay-mk3: Stores EMC from collectors, adds a bonus and passes it on to condensers, furnaces and other relays.
blockdesc-novaexplosive-catalyst: Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to light it. Explodes after a few seconds, dropping what it breaks.
blockdesc-novaexplosive-cataclysm: A much bigger nova catalyst. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to light it.
blockdesc-interdictiontorch: Keeps hostile creatures away from it.
blockdesc-pedestal-empty: Right-click with a ring, stone, amulet or talisman to set it here; it then works on the area around the pedestal for free.
blockdesc-pedestal-active: Right-click with an empty hand to take back what's on it.
eye-notarget: No block chosen - sneak + right-click a block to choose one.
divining-result: {0} blocks deep: {1} EMC in total, {2} per block on average. Most valuable: {3} ({4} EMC).
furnace-burning: Burning: {0}s of heat left, {1} EMC stored
furnace-cold: Cold - add fuel or feed it EMC ({1} EMC stored)
relay-bonus: Bonus: {0} EMC/s, passes on up to {1} EMC/s
blockhelp-relay-withdraw: Take stored EMC (empty hand or Klein star)
